summary: Direct Floquet analysis of the flip-flop orbit at Re = 62. The leading pair lies just outside the unit circle.
description: Leading Floquet exponent sigma + i omega of the flip-flop orbit at Re = 62, row 1 of Spectre_NSd.dat, for the period T = 8.815129 (time stamp of BF_2cyl0.f00001, Newton at 1199 steps per period). The pair is just above the imaginary axis: the Neimark-Sacker bifurcation sits at Re_c,2 = 61.17. The orbits of Newton with and without a stored orbit give exponents 1.1e-7 apart in sigma and 2e-7 in omega; an orbit converged at another step count (1212 instead of 1199) moves sigma by 4e-6. The tolerance is 1e-6.
